description: Set up the Rust helper for Windows compilation. Add windows-sys/windows crate dependencies behind #[cfg(windows)], configure Cargo.toml target-specific deps, set up MSVC linker config, and verify the helper compiles on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc. Include a CI smoke step that cross-compiles from Linux or builds natively on a Windows runner.
title: Windows Cargo build + cross-compilation setup
